concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged `[P]` (parallel-safe) but is the foundational setup task ('Establish the project layout, pinned dependencies'). All subsequent tasks depend on the environment and config established here; it cannot be executed in parallel with consumers.

Task T009 is tagged `[P]` (parallel-safe) but includes a 'fresh-runner reproducibility check'. This check is a consumer of all previous implementation and data-generation tasks and must be the final sequential gate.
